premises.text: Sharing and getting local breaking news is weak today: not reliably real-time, accurate, local, or relevant
premises.evidence_span: sharing and getting news right now kind of sucks

premises.text: A location-based mobile and web news desk lets users report and read map-pinned local stories with text, photos, and video
premises.evidence_span: Me Porter is your local mobile news desk, allowing you to report, update, and read local news as it happens on your mobile phone

premises.text: On-scene users can check in as eyewitnesses and add their own accounts and media
premises.evidence_span: we allow you to check in as an eyewitness

premises.text: Badges and press-pass rewards incentivize posting and can be redeemed for tangible prizes
premises.evidence_span: we have a rewards program that we've built out in the app as well to reward people for posting the news

premises.text: Monetization via promoted stories, publisher data syndication, in-app/web ads, and category sponsorships
premises.evidence_span: we're going to allow people to actually promote their news stories at the top of the search results
